author: MIDINS Forge
description: Open-source intelligence gathering for domains and usernames.

scripts.title: Whois
scripts.description: Look up domain registration details. Enter a bare domain such as example.com, not a full URL.

scripts.title: Dig — DNS Records
scripts.description: Query DNS records for a domain.

scripts.title: theHarvester
scripts.description: Collect email addresses, subdomains, and hosts from public sources.

scripts.title: Sherlock — Username Search
scripts.description: Search hundreds of social networks for a username.

scripts.title: Amass — Enumeration
scripts.description: Map an organization's external attack surface, including subdomains and ASNs.

scripts.title: Shodan — Search
scripts.description: Search for exposed devices and services with the Shodan API (API key required).

scripts.title: Robots.txt
scripts.description: Fetch robots.txt, which can reveal publicly listed paths.
